intent: End the transcript strip abruptly and keep no-report, early-cutoff and unknown-cause labels separate. Their co-occurrence must not become a fatal-event diagram.
source:
**Frame:** `53927`'s retained transcript ends shortly after the experiment. Beside the cutoff are three labels: `NO REPORT`, `TRANSCRIPT ENDS EARLY`, `CAUSE NOT ESTABLISHED`.

**Caption:**
> THE BOARD CALLS IT PERMANENT.
>
> THE RECORD DOES NOT SHOW ENOUGH TO PROVE WHAT HAPPENED TO THE PROCESS.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `inferred` — early transcript ending is sourced; the uncertainty statement prevents overclaim.
title: The transcript ends without establishing a cause
